title: Readiness Estimator: Mars Settlement Charters
definition: Estimates Mars Settlement Charters readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Mars Settlement Charters components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a charter hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Mars Settlement Charters Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Mars Settlement Charters operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Mars Settlement Charters installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 36430 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where martian law monitoring, charter logistics redundancy, or Earth relations maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Mars Settlement Charters Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Mars Settlement Charters: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Mars Settlement Charters — charters for self-governing Mars cities.

Phase 1 — Prove (martian law): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (charter logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (Earth relations): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (independence paths): charter hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and Mars-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
